grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: A Small Change at the Office
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和题目都是模拟材料，不是真实考试。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自短文。
passage:
A Small Change at the Office

Last month, the company where I work started a new program. The program is called “Green Office.” The goal is to reduce waste and save energy. All employees received an email about it.

The email explained the reasons for the program. First, the company spends a lot of money on electricity and paper. Second, the company wants to protect the environment. Therefore, the managers asked everyone to help.

The program has three simple rules. First, turn off your computer when you leave the office. Second, use both sides of the paper when you print. Third, bring your own cup for coffee. The company also put recycling bins in every room.

At first, some people forgot the rules. For example, my colleague Tom often left his computer on. He said, “I’m in a hurry in the evening.” But after two weeks, he remembered. Now he turns it off every day.

I think the program is a good idea. If we all follow the rules, we will save money and help the environment. If you want to join, you should talk to your manager. You can also suggest new ideas. For example, you could ask for a bike rack. Then more people might ride bicycles to work.

The program is only one month old, but we already see some changes. We use less paper, and the recycling bins are full every week. I believe small actions can make a big difference.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the new program?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段提到“The program is called ‘Green Office.’”，所以答案是 Green Office。

questions.prompt: Why did the company start the program?
options: To reduce waste and save energy
answers: To reduce waste and save energy
questions.explanation: 第一段说“The goal is to reduce waste and save energy.”，因此目的是减少浪费和节约能源。
questions.evidence: The goal is to reduce waste and save energy.

questions.prompt: According to the email, what are the reasons for the program?
options: The company spends a lot of money on electricity and paper, and wants to protect the environment.
The company wants to buy new furniture.
The employees asked for a longer lunch break.
The company wants to reduce the number of employees.
answers: The company spends a lot of money on electricity and paper, and wants to protect the environment.
questions.explanation: 第二段提到两个原因：公司花很多钱在电和纸上，以及想保护环境。
questions.evidence: First, the company spends a lot of money on electricity and paper. Second, the company wants to protect the environment.

questions.prompt: What is one of the rules of the program?
options: Turn off your computer when you leave the office.
Use only one side of the paper.
answers: Turn off your computer when you leave the office.
questions.explanation: 第三段第一条规则是“turn off your computer when you leave the office”。
questions.evidence: First, turn off your computer when you leave the office.

questions.prompt: What did Tom often do at first?
options: He used both sides of the paper.
questions.explanation: 第四段说“my colleague Tom often left his computer on.”，所以汤姆起初常不关电脑。
questions.evidence: my colleague Tom often left his computer on.

questions.prompt: What will happen if everyone follows the rules?
options: They will save money and help the environment.
answers: They will save money and help the environment.
questions.explanation: 第五段说“If we all follow the rules, we will save money and help the environment.”，因此答案是节省钱并帮助环境。
questions.evidence: If we all follow the rules, we will save money and help the environment.

questions.prompt: What can you do if you want to join the program?
questions.explanation: 第五段说“If you want to join, you should talk to your manager.”，所以应该和经理谈谈。
questions.evidence: If you want to join, you should talk to your manager.

options: Small actions can make a big difference.
The company should stop the program.
answers: Small actions can make a big difference.
questions.explanation: 最后一段说“I believe small actions can make a big difference.”，所以作者相信小行动能带来大改变。
questions.evidence: I believe small actions can make a big difference.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: The company also put recycling bins in every ______.
questions.explanation: 第三段最后一句说“The company also put recycling bins in every room.”，所以填 room。
questions.evidence: The company also put recycling bins in every room.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The program started six months ago.
questions.explanation: 短文最后一段说“The program is only one month old”，所以“六个月前开始”是错误的。
questions.evidence: The program is only one month old

grammar.title: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句表示“如果……就会……”，结构是 If + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。情态动词 should 表示建议，could 表示可能的建议。
grammar.example: If we all follow the rules, we will save money and help the environment.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，主句用 will + 动词原形，所以选 will stay。
questions.evidence: If we all follow the rules, we will save money and help the environment.

questions.prompt: I turned off the light ______ I wanted to save energy.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因，这里“想节约能源”是原因，所以选 because。
questions.evidence: First, the company spends a lot of money on electricity and paper. Second, the company wants to protect the environment.

questions.prompt: You ______ talk to your manager if you want to join the program.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议，这里建议和经理谈谈，所以选 should。
questions.evidence: If you want to join, you should talk to your manager.

questions.prompt: The company wants to save money; ______, it started the program.
questions.explanation: therefore 表示结果，这里“想省钱”是原因，“开始项目”是结果，所以选 therefore。
questions.evidence: Therefore, the managers asked everyone to help.
